rust_summary: an online player's `textures` property (`native_player_textures`) and a head stack of any player (`native_player_head`).
doc_summary: `native_player_textures(uuid)` gives the `textures` property (value and signature) of a player who is on, and `native_player_head(uuid)` a `minecraft:player_head` whose profile holds the player's id, plus their name and skin when they are on. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_textures@.
